upstream.unresolved_note: ⚠️ Named as part of the reserve and not identified by instrument or issuer, so it cannot be resolved or scored.

dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: ⚠️ One resolution per entry: `slug` / `slugs` / `terminal`+`kind` / `unresolved`. TERMINAL = nothing is missing. UNRESOLVED = a report is owed. Never merged. Bar set 2026-10-01: terminal requires the report to POSITIVELY STATE the backing; a peg_mechanism label is not evidence.
dependencies.edge_kind_rule: `backing` = my SOLVENCY depends on it. `venue` = my EXIT PRICE does.
dependencies.coverage_note: ⚠️ RECORDED 2026-10-01. 1 dependent (stcusd). Cap Labs, MegaETH ecosystem. ⚠️ The report notes it is MARKETED as USDC/USD-backed while the reserve is blue-chip stablecoins plus a tokenized MMF — so the marketing and the composition are not the same claim.

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.
